description: List the files in one KNMI Data Platform dataset, newest first by default. Returns filename, size in bytes, creation and last-modified timestamps, plus a page token. This is how you find the most recent radar composite, observation file or model run before downloading it. Get dataset and version from knmi_datasets, e.g. dataset "10-minute-in-situ-meteorological-observations" version "1.0", or dataset "radar_reflectivity_composites" version "2.0".

begin.description: Only with order_by "filename": start listing alphabetically after this filename.

page_token.description: nextPageToken from a previous call, to fetch the following page.

name: knmi_dataset_files
title: Knmi Dataset Files
